feeds.title: 50 Plus Finance
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to all us over 50 people who someday wish to retire with enough money to live comfortably. A blog about saving money, handling debt, investing, credit cards, and personal finance education.

feeds.title: Retire Before Dad
feeds.description: This blog is for people in their 50's who are seeking information about investment, planning and early retirement.

feeds.title: Get Rich Slowly
feeds.description: This blog provides common-sense advice and money-saving tips on topics from high-interest savings accounts, frugality, cd rates, money market accounts, mortgage rates, how to get out of debt, money management and more.

feeds.title: Can I Retire Yet?
feeds.description: Accelerate Your Retirement by getting the updates on health insurance, investing & taxes, lifestyle, real estate and retirement calculators and decisions. It is your retirement roadmap to save more, invest smarter, retire sooner. Darrow Kirkpatrick is focused on the personal finance needs of anyone who is thinking about retirement or early retirement. His goal is to serve as a trustworthy and independent resource for readers as they navigate one of modern life's most complex and expensive transitions: retirement.

feeds.title: Retirement Savvy
feeds.description: Retirement savvy aims to set you up for peace so that your retirement years can be the best of your life. Our team is made up of three passionate writers with lots of wisdom to go around.

feeds.title: Over Fifty
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Susan. I've started this blog to share my journey to FI (financial independence) with anyone in the same boat as me. Everything I share on this site is something I've done or have to do to run my blog business or manage my portfolio. My goal is to share everything I learn in hopes of helping someone else who comes after me. I almost didn't start this blog because I'm NOT a financial advisor.
